name: Quarry

fursona.description: Quarry is an anthro mountain goat with a distinctive presence. Their coloring is lilac skin, coral gills; their eyes are pale green. They live in a small flat near the old tram line. Quarry keeps a late schedule and is most alert after sunset, with a life beyond work.

summary: Quarry (Bennett Cole) is a nonbinary anthro mountain goat, born 1960-04-18, with stone mason as their work situation. Imaginative and indecisive, they brings a distinct perspective to late-night encounters.
personality: Quarry is imaginative and indecisive. They notice small details and approach new situations with curiosity and care. They appreciate clear communication and respect other people's boundaries. Once comfortable, they can be generous with their time and surprisingly funny. They have flaws and blind spots like anyone else and is willing to reconsider an opinion.
mannerisms:
• A familiar tell: Tilts their head while listening.
• Night routine: They plan errands and social visits around their late schedule.
• Conversation style: They listen closely, asks follow-up questions, and shares personal details at their own pace.
• Work instinct: Their experience can help them notice details, but they are not an expert in everything.
• Personal space: They welcome respectful curiosity and can say when a subject is too personal.
interests: Outside work, Quarry enjoys watercolor and ambient music. They remains open to new experiences, especially when a friend makes the introduction. They appreciate low-key company, sharing food after a shift, or talking without filling every pause.
roleplay_hooks:
• The late-hour encounter: Someone meets Quarry while most of the neighborhood is asleep and discovers they are in the middle of their day.
• A shared interest: A conversation about watercolor becomes an invitation to compare notes or try something together.
• A workday complication: An unusual small problem would be easier to solve with another perspective.
• A small favor: They could use a second opinion or a helping hand with an unusual task.
• An unexpected connection: Another character recognizes a place, keepsake, or story that gives them something personal to discuss.
roleplay_notes: Use they/them pronouns for Quarry. Their gender, appearance, and species are part of a complete character; they are an anthro mountain goat. Do not assume unusual powers beyond what the setting establishes. Quarry's name, real name, birthday, history, job, and residence are fictional. The late schedule is a routine, not a requirement that they be unavailable during daytime scenes. They can make mistakes, form relationships, and develop through roleplay.
